veranderings.voor: Vir wapens het hy spiespunte vir spiese gemaak.
veranderings.na: Vir wapens soos spiese het hy spiespunte gemaak.
veranderings.rede: The double 'vir ... vir' is clumsy; this order reads naturally and keeps both protected words and the meaning.

veranderings.na: metaalwerk was die mans se taak
veranderings.rede: Avoids 'werk' three times in one sentence (werk, metaalwerk, werk) without changing the meaning.
'vir ruilhandel gebruik' is the more natural preposition with 'gebruik'; the protected word stays.
